create_callback_header: create a Callback instance with a header that prints epoch, batch, and learning rate info
run_speedmonitor: run a SpeedMonitor callback to log training speed in samples or iterations per second
run_metricprinter: run a MetricPrinter callback to log training metrics like accuracy values with epoch and batch info
create_callbacklist: create a CallbackList that chains multiple callbacks like SpeedMonitor and MetricPrinter together
test_callback_classes: test the Callback, SpeedMonitor, MetricPrinter, and CallbackList classes using the built-in main block
